card.name: Linking word before 'reduce the risk'
card.fires_on: The word 'to' (or a verb like 'were'/'are') right before an expected 'reduce' or 'reduce the risk of' phrase, mostly in instructions to adjust or rotate something to prevent a problem.

modes.label: Purpose 'to' in instructions
modes.description: The word 'to' after an action, leading into 'reduce the risk of' an adverse effect.
modes.example: • Rotate injection sites<< to>> reduce risk of lipodystrophy and

modes.label: Verb before a risk comparison
modes.description: 'were' or 'are' in news text about groups with changed risk, before a risk-lowering or risk-change phrase.
modes.example: For decades, researchers have known that people who carry a gene for sickle cell anemia<< are>> highly resistant to dying from malaria.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words meaning reduce or lower, and away from words meaning enhance or increase.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says something will lower a risk.
